correctness.rationale: All 871 augmented faces verified by two enumerators. Exact 408-pair acyclic Morse matching checked over 2910 Hasse incidences; integer unit Smith rank 10 from C3 to C2 and zero C4 differential. Two independent original simplicial integer H2 cocycles are checked on 310 three-simplices. Ten lifted integral 4-cycles all have exact zero boundary and all forty cup evaluations vanish, annihilating all Hopf and mixed Whitehead attaching components over the torsionfree pi3 of two 2-spheres. Independent full original F2 chain ranks agree, but are not substituted for integral evidence.

value.rationale: The natural bidirected wheel bridges known polygonal and tree multipath constructions, and its first compact hub-and-cycle example has nonzero homology in three consecutive dimensions. The exact integral wedge decomposition resolves the nontrivial question of Hopf/Whitehead four-cell attachments; field-only Betti numbers could not show it, and the result is a self-contained structural classification of a canonical finite symmetric graph.
